description: Prolog/Datalog exporter — projects the canonical TSV graph into engine-agnostic logical facts and ships runnable rule sets and example queries for both SWI-Prolog (interactive research querying via pyswip) and Souffle (high-performance bulk Datalog), enabling symbolic inference over the cultural network. This is the least-charted path; treat as original engineering.

tasks.title: T5-US-001: Add the datalog exporter module and define the fact model
tasks.description:
As a developer, I need a canonical, engine-neutral fact representation before targeting any specific engine.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Create src/culturescrape/datalog/__init__.py and define a Fact dataclass (predicate, args, optional source)
- Document the predicate schema in docs/datalog.md: node/3+, instance_of/2, rel/3 (or typed predicates per :TYPE), and dimension facts (time_start/2, located_in/2, descends_from/2, ...)
- Provide a function to safely render an atom (quoting/escaping identifiers and string literals validly for Prolog and Datalog)
- Tests pass (pytest) for atom escaping incl. quotes, spaces, and unicode
- Type checks pass (mypy)

Project context: culture-scrape — see PLAN.md, docs/data-model.md, docs/prior-art.md. Work in the repo root (src/culturescrape/). This story belongs to tasklist 'ralph/datalog-exporter'.

tasks.title: T5-US-002: Map node TSV rows to facts
tasks.description:
As a developer, I want every node row to become well-formed facts so entities exist in the logic program.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Each node emits node(Csid, Type, Name) plus one fact per populated dimension column (e.g. time_start(Csid, Year), located_at(Csid, Lat, Lon), language_code(Csid, Code))
- csids are turned into valid lowercase atoms or quoted atoms deterministically; mapping is reversible-documented
- Null/empty columns emit no fact (no nulls in the logic program)
- Tests pass (pytest) mapping a fixture node file to the expected fact set
- Type checks pass (mypy)

Project context: culture-scrape — see PLAN.md, docs/data-model.md, docs/prior-art.md. Work in the repo root (src/culturescrape/). This story belongs to tasklist 'ralph/datalog-exporter'.

tasks.title: T5-US-003: Map edge TSV rows to facts
tasks.description:
As a developer, I want every edge to become a relation fact so the graph structure is in logic.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Each edge emits a typed predicate per :TYPE (e.g. located_in(A,B), derived_from(A,B)) and also a generic rel(Type,A,B) for uniform queries
- Predicate names are derived from :TYPE via a documented, collision-free lowercasing scheme
- Edge weight/confidence is exposed via an optional companion fact (e.g. rel_conf(Type,A,B,Conf))
- Tests pass (pytest) mapping a fixture edge file to expected facts
- Type checks pass (mypy)

Project context: culture-scrape — see PLAN.md, docs/data-model.md, docs/prior-art.md. Work in the repo root (src/culturescrape/). This story belongs to tasklist 'ralph/datalog-exporter'.

tasks.title: T5-US-004: Emit a SWI-Prolog program (.pl)
tasks.description:

- Tests pass (pytest): the generated .pl parses; the swipl load test passes or is skipped

tasks.title: T5-US-005: Emit a Souffle program (.dl) with type declarations
tasks.description:
As a data miner, I want a Souffle datalog file so I can run high-performance bulk inference.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Generate a .dl file with .decl declarations for every predicate, .input/.output directives, and facts loaded from generated .facts TSV files (Souffle's native format)
- souffle compiles/runs the program in a smoke test (skipped automatically if souffle is not installed, with the skip reason logged)
- Generated .facts files reuse the strict TSV writer so they are lossless
- Tests pass (pytest): generated .dl is well-formed; the souffle run test passes or is skipped
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T5-US-006: Author a shared rule library for derived relations
tasks.description:
As a researcher, I want inference rules so the logic layer adds value beyond the raw facts.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Define rules (in both Prolog and Souffle syntax) for: transitive descends_from (ancestor/2), transitive located_in (within_region/2), contemporary_with as symmetric closure, and an influenced_transitively/2 over derived_from/influenced_by
- Each rule has a documented intended meaning and a worked example query
- Rules are stored as templates so they attach to any generated program
- Tests pass (pytest) checking the rule text is emitted into both .pl and .dl outputs
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T5-US-007: Validate inference equivalence across engines on a fixture
tasks.description:
As a user, I want confidence that Prolog and Souffle agree so results are trustworthy.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- On a fixture graph, run the same query (e.g. ancestor/2 closure) in swipl and souffle and assert identical result sets
- Test skips gracefully (with logged reason) if either engine is unavailable, but runs in CI when both are present
- Differences, if any, are reported with the diverging tuples
- Tests pass (pytest) for the equivalence check (or skip with reason)
- Type checks pass (mypy)
